release_notes: Added automatic Operator Identity support for Morsewurst Network.
Operator identities are generated and managed automatically by the app.
Added shareable MWOP listener codes for following and verifying a specific operator.
Added Ed25519-based operator authentication between clients and the relay.
The relay now verifies operator signatures before marking a session as verified.
The relay now checks that operator IDs match their public keys.
Added protection against spoofed operator fields in runtime key and tone messages.
Added server-trusted operator_id and operator_verified fields to relayed messages.
Added read-only listener mode for monitoring rooms without transmit rights.
Added optional operator filtering for listener clients.
Private room passwords remain required and are not bypassed by Operator Identity.
Kept key telemetry as V1 while moving the WebSocket envelope protocol to V5.
Fixed remaining server-info messages to use the central V5 protocol helper.
Improved server-safe network imports for minimal relay installations.
Improved listener CLI error handling for cleaner failures.
Added an Operator Identity section to the Network settings UI.
Added copy, export, import and regenerate actions for the local Operator Identity.
Added a button for opening the current profile data folder from the Operator Identity section.
Improved Operator Identity wording and security guidance in the supported UI languages.
Clarified that the listener code is safe to share, while exported identity files contain a private key and must be kept private.
Improved the update dialog so long release notes are no longer truncated after short text limits.
Raised release-note validation and display limits to support longer update descriptions.
Added and updated regression tests for Operator Identity, listener mode, spoofing protection and protocol version handling.
Updated Network documentation for Operator Identity, listener mode and V5/V1 protocol behaviour.
